 Order

The present petition is filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India being aggrieved by the inaction on the part of the respondent No.1 in not deciding the application for reference filed by the petitioner u/S.64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: It is submitted against the award, the application for reference is pending since March 2023 before the respondent No.1.

After considering the aforesaid grievance of the petitioner, I deem it expedient to dispose off the present petition with a direction to the respondent No.1 Collector, District Dhar to consider and decide the pending application of the petitioner for reference u/S.64 of the Act 2013 within a period of two months from the date of communication of the order by passing a reasoned and speaking order if the application is not already decided.
With the aforesaid, writ petition is disposed off.
(VIVEK RUSIA) JUDGE Praveen Gendalal vs District Collector.

opennyai_summary.facts:
The present petition is filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India being aggrieved by the inaction on the part of the respondent No.1 in not deciding the application for reference filed by the petitioner u/S.64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
It is submitted against the award, the application for reference is pending since March 2023 before the respondent No.1.
opennyai_summary.decision:

With the aforesaid, writ petition is disposed off.
